name: Methylene blue
description: Blue thiazine dye; given into a vein as a drug (ProvayBlue) for acquired methemoglobinemia

note.text: No published trial of methylene blue for energy or fatigue. A related compound, LMTM, showed no benefit in a Phase 3 Alzheimer's trial.

bullets: **Label:** converted to leucomethylene blue, which turns methemoglobin back to hemoglobin
**Label:** appears to be a potent reversible MAO inhibitor
**Lab and animal:** reroutes electrons in mitochondria; protects brain cells in models
**For energy in people,** the mechanism is not established
FDA approved IV drug (2016) for methemoglobinemia
No trial for energy or fatigue

notEstablished.text: Oral use for thinking or mood

practical.routes: Into a vein (label); by mouth in brain studies
practical.pharmacokinetics: Mainly UGT conjugation; CYP1A2, 2C19, 2D6 in vitro; liver

references: Radiology, single-dose methylene blue and brain MRI, Nov 2016
Lancet, LMTM Phase 3 trial in Alzheimer's disease, Dec 2016
